messages:
maria_pm: ACME wants a mid-contract top-up (+25%) on their private marketplace commit. Need a quick ops + HW alignment.
jordan_sales: Can we treat as additive (no new discount tier)? Customer prefers same unit price.
samir_si: SI asks for co-marketing + 2-week announce embargo. Also wants a hardware rebate tied to consumption milestone.
maria_pm: Ops check: Partner Portal amendment required. If we add HW SKUs it becomes new private offer (+5 business days).
hw_partner_bot: HW partner flagged: rebate okay if billing metric maps to appliance usage SKU. Need SKU list.
jordan_sales: Action owners: maria_pm to submit amendment draft, samir_si to confirm co-marketing timeline, I'll confirm PO/finance path.
maria_pm: Draft will include: commit delta, billing SKU map, pricing floor (no deeper discount), effective date, renewal alert sync. Posting draft by EOD.
